tagline: Eat what you have. Waste less, every day.
have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
new_account: New to EatMe? Create an account
verify_email: Check your email to verify your account, then sign in.
reset_sent: If an account exists, you will receive email instructions.
development_login: Local development environment. Use fictional data. Email addresses are not verified.
make_it_yours: A kitchen that feels like yours.
name: What’s your name?
household_question: How many people do you usually cook for?
adult_confirmation: I confirm I am at least 18 years old.
diet_question: How do you like to eat?
diet_hint: Choose one or more styles. You can change them any time.
strictness: How closely do you follow them?
medical_review_note: These profiles, including RAD, become available after their rules and sources are reviewed.
restrictions_hint: Allergies and intolerances are separate from preferences. Only add what you choose to disclose.
health_consent: I consent to using my allergy and intolerance data for the features I request. I can remove them from my profile. EatMe does not replace professional medical advice.
offline_inventory: Saved inventory: it may be out of date. Reconnect to make changes.
empty_fridge_body: Add the food you have at home. We’ll take it from there.
use_by_passed: The use-by date has passed. This batch is excluded from suggested cooking allocations.
no_recipes_body: Try another mode or check the food and quantities in your Fridge.
preference_warning: This recipe differs from a flexible preference.
online_required: Reconnect to check your current profile.
no_known_conflict: No conflict in the available data
nutrition_unavailable: Nutrition values are not yet available. No score is calculated.
check_package: Always check the actual product packaging: the demonstration catalog does not certify the absence of allergens.
evidence_unavailable: No reviewed scientific source is attached to this demonstration record.
demo_data_not_a_safety_guarantee: Assessment based on demonstration data. It is not a safety guarantee for the actual food.
contains_allergen: Contains an allergen declared in your profile.
may_contain_allergen: May contain an allergen in your profile: check the packaging.
diet_exclusion: Conflict with a selected dietary style.
never_suggest: This food is excluded by your preferences.
unknown_ingredient: An ingredient could not be fully identified.
rule_not_evaluable: A rule cannot be evaluated: compatibility is not confirmed.
validation_explanation: Ingredients were checked against the declared restrictions and the rule versions listed below.
missing_ingredients_notice: Some quantities are missing from your Fridge. You can adjust the actual quantities used before confirming.
confirm_consumption_hint: These amounts will be deducted from your Fridge. Tap an ingredient to adjust the actual consumption.
consumption_shortage: Insufficient quantities: update your Fridge or specify what you used from the recorded products.
leftover_date_unknown: Leftovers will be recorded without an automatically estimated expiry date.
privacy_body: Your profile personalizes recipes. Allergy and intolerance data is used only with your consent and is not sent to advertising services. You can remove it by editing your profile and obtain a copy of your recorded data.
delete_confirm: Permanently delete your account and personal data? Shared ownership must first be transferred. Store subscriptions must be cancelled separately.
network_error: Connection unavailable. Check your network and try again.
authentication_failed: Sign-in failed. Check your details or try again.
password_length: The password must be 12 to 128 characters long.
account_unavailable: This account is unavailable for registration.
forbidden: You do not have access to this operation.
auth_mode_mismatch: The app’s authentication setup does not match the server.
invalid_profile: Enter your name and confirm you are at least 18.
health_consent_required: Confirm consent to use allergy and intolerance data.
duplicate_diet: The same diet was selected twice.
diet_rules_unavailable: A profile’s rules are unavailable. Review your selected diets.
medical_profiles_not_released: This profile still requires scientific review.
stale_profile: Your profile changed. Refresh before confirming.
stale_inventory: Your Fridge changed. Refresh the summary before confirming.
insufficient_inventory: There is not enough in your inventory.
invalid_quantity: Enter a valid quantity with up to three decimal places.
expiry_type_required: Provide both the date and its meaning.
whole_units_required: Enter a whole number of pieces for this food.
invalid_leftovers: Leftover servings cannot exceed prepared servings.
recipe_not_compatible: This recipe is not compatible with your current profile.
rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
idempotency_conflict: The request changed. Refresh the screen and try again.
ownership_transfer_required: Transfer household ownership before leaving or deleting your account.
account_deletion_not_configured: Account deletion is not configured yet.
medical_consent: I consent to using my condition-associated nutrition profile. I understand that EatMe does not replace individualized advice from a physician or dietitian.
medical_consent_required: Confirm the dedicated medical nutrition consent.
shopping_intro: A little planning. A better meal.
shopping_empty_body: Add what you need or build a list from your meal plan.
household_privacy: Share your pantry while keeping personal profiles private. Invitations expire after seven days.
share_constraints: Use my constraints for shared meals
share_constraints_body: Allow household members to check shared meals against your dietary constraints. You can withdraw this consent at any time.
leftover_dates_notice: Dates are set by you. They do not establish food safety.
leftover_empty_body: Save remaining portions after cooking and find them here.
private_import_notice: Imported recipes stay private. Map every ingredient and review the instructions before saving.
scan_review_notice: Recognition and quantities may be wrong. Confirm the food, amount and package information before adding anything.
recipe_idea: What would you like to cook?
ai_consent_body: This sends your selected image or text to the configured AI provider. Health profile fields are excluded. Images are encrypted and deleted from our storage within 24 hours. Review all results.
development_fixture: Development fixture · this is not image recognition.
confirm_identification: I checked this food and quantity
verify_package: Check the package for current ingredients, traces and allergens. Database information may be incomplete.
pref_learning_body: Use recipe likes and dislikes to reorder suggestions.
pref_analytics_body: Only approved usage events; no diet, allergy or recipe details.
pref_ai_consent_body: Allow selected images and text to be sent to the configured AI provider.
pref_seasonal_body: Use seasonality only where the catalog contains reviewed regional data.
notification_privacy: You control categories, quiet hours and the daily limit.
evidence_unknown_body: Personalized claims require current, reviewed evidence. No answer is generated when that evidence is missing.
insights_method: Based on your latest 100 meals and 2,000 inventory events. Money and carbon savings are not estimated without a validated method.
sync_notice: Pending changes are encrypted on this device. Conflicts require review; cooking always needs a live check.
queued_offline: Saved on this device. Sync when connected.
cached_view: Offline copy · it may have changed elsewhere.
participant_consent_required: A selected diner has not agreed to share constraints.
invitation_unavailable: This invitation is expired, revoked or already used.
product_provider_not_configured: Product lookup is not configured on this server.
ai_provider_not_configured: Assisted processing is not configured on this server.
ai_quota_exceeded: The processing limit for this month has been reached.
provider_unavailable: The data provider is unavailable. Try again later.
provider_rate_limited: The provider is busy. Please try again shortly.
product_not_found: No product was found for this barcode.
invalid_barcode: Check the barcode digits and try again.
leftover_date_passed: Your planned use date has passed. Review the leftover.
household_changed: This change belongs to another household. Switch back before syncing.
offline_queue_full: Sync your pending changes before adding more.
package_count: Number of packages checked against the label
subscription_notice: Store subscriptions renew according to the terms shown by the store. You can restore purchases or manage cancellation in your store account.
no_offerings: No subscription offerings are currently available.
store_unavailable: The store is unavailable. Please try again later.
diner_consent_notice: Selected diners must enable constraint sharing in their household settings.
nutrition_method: Calculated from available ingredient data. Cooking losses and retention are not modeled.
partial_nutrition: Partial total · some ingredients have no data
review_recipe_steps: I reviewed the ingredients, quantities and every preparation step.
reauthentication_required: Sign in again to confirm account deletion.
apple_reauthentication_required: Sign in with Apple again before deleting your account.
account_deletion_pending: Account deletion is in progress. Your access to personal data is closed.
reauthenticate_body: Sign in with the same account, then return here to confirm deletion.
recalled_batch: This lot matches a published recall. Do not consume it. Check the source instructions.
operation_in_progress: An update is already in progress.
remix_notice: Reuse prepared leftovers and add only the new ingredients below. Review the preparation steps. Original ingredients will not be deducted from your Fridge again.
remix_prepared: I reviewed the steps and prepared this meal.
leftover_provenance_unavailable: The original ingredients could not be verified.
batch_not_usable: This batch is past its use-by date or matches a recall.
budget_notice: Uses ingredient availability to reduce extra shopping. This is not a price estimate.
report_notice: Describe the problem without passwords or unnecessary health details.
archive_recipe_body: Remove this recipe from your collection? Previous cooking records are retained.
leave_household_body: Shared inventory stays with this household. You will return to another household or a new personal kitchen.
chef_subtitle: Here is what you can cook today.
expiry_summary: {count} items have a recorded date within the next three days.
custom_food_notice: Visible to your household. Ingredients and allergens remain unverified until reviewed.
self_reported_habits: Mark the days you followed your habits. These are your own check-ins, not a nutritional or clinical assessment.
choose_habit: Choose a goal below and set a realistic weekly target.
nutrition_score_unavailable: A validated nutrition score is not available for this food.
unknown_ingredients: The complete ingredient and allergen information has not been verified.
invalid_timer: Enter a whole number from 1 to 180 minutes.
cooking_saved: Your meal is recorded and your pantry is updated.
saved_leftover_count: {count} leftover servings saved. Add your storage date in Leftovers.
external_leftovers_notice: For food prepared outside EatMe. Choose the exact recipe you used. Saving this entry does not deduct ingredients from your pantry.
create_recipe_first: Create the recipe in your recipe library first, including all ingredients.
confirm_leftover_ingredients: I checked that these are all the ingredients in my leftovers.
recorded_quantities_notice: Quantities come from recorded inventory actions, grouped by unit. They do not measure waste prevented or carbon savings.
practical_tips: Check dates before planning meals, add only what you need to your shopping list, and label saved leftovers.

legal_configuration_required: Registration is unavailable until the service operator configures the legal pages.

favorite_limit: The favorites limit has been reached.
